notes: *As through* is kept whole on כְּ as one rendering rather than leaving *through* `added`; the margin's *Or, As a wide breaking in of waters* was read and set aside (rule 38).
תַּחַת → *In the midst of* heads on *midst*, the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24).
The italic *upon me* supplies both a preposition and an object pronoun the Hebrew never writes, so it is one `added` unit (rules 30 and 44).
